_note: The move table's cells for the coverage probe (sim/input/tools/coverage_probe.gd; A-CONTROLS-06; docs/controls/coverage-probe.md). One object per cell: id (layer/button/press, layer/stick/flick|hold/direction, pair/name), layer (none, LB, RB, RT, LT, or pair), kind, pre (pad events before the press: the held layer), script (the press), by_design (a sentence when the cell is empty on purpose, from Combat's design page; empty means the cell is expected to do something). Event forms: [tick, 'b', control, down], [tick, 't', control, value], [tick, 'ls' or 'rs', '', x, y]; negative ticks are before the press. Add a cell by adding an object; nothing in the probe's code names a cell. Combat's fields (S4, 2026-11-14): combat is own, by_design, proposed (a share Combat proposes and Game Design has to write down), gap_alpha (work before Alpha) or gap_probe (the probe can't read it yet); proposed and note explain. The probe reads only by_design. The 15 cells marked added_by need four new layers in the probe's baseline list: brawl, brawlLT, brawlLB, air.
